newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down in market correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down in market correction.

text.p: Dhaka shares dipped more than three percent at close because of a market correction, that began a day earlier to end a four-day rally, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 109.1 points or 3.03 percent at 3,486.88. Turnover was at 217.4 million. Of 114 traded issues, 95 lost and 19 rose.

Brokers said the bearish trend might continue for some more sessions as investors were bent on booking profit. Shine Pukur Holdings could offset a selling pressure gaining 31.05 taka to 652.48 after it announced a plan to possess a 40 percent stake in a proposed cement plant. Apex Foods shed 1,057.08 to 20,084.59.
